title: Dimmer
brief: A potentiometer is a resistor with a slider on it: the middle leg (wiper) moves along the track as you turn the knob.
Use the middle leg and one end, and it's a resistor you can turn from 0 Ω to 10 kΩ.
Why is R1 there as well? Try it without and find out. (The bin has spare LEDs.)
lesson: A pot turned to one end is 0 Ω. The fixed resistor keeps a ceiling on the current: a blue LED drops about 3 V, so never more than (5 − 3) ÷ 220 ≈ 9 mA.
